import numpy as np
def softmax(x, axis=-1):
    e = np.exp(x - np.max(x, axis=axis, keepdims=True)); return e / e.sum(axis=axis, keepdims=True)
def attention(Q, K, V):
    Q = np.asarray(Q, float); K = np.asarray(K, float); V = np.asarray(V, float)
    d_k = Q.shape[-1]
    w = softmax((Q @ K.T) / np.sqrt(d_k), axis=-1)
    return w @ V

import numpy as np
def cov_corr(x, y):
    x = np.asarray(x, float); y = np.asarray(y, float); n = x.size
    mx, my = x.mean(), y.mean()
    cov = ((x - mx) * (y - my)).sum() / n
    sx = (((x - mx) ** 2).sum() / n) ** 0.5
    sy = (((y - my) ** 2).sum() / n) ** 0.5
    corr = cov / (sx * sy)
    return cov, corr

reference_solution:
import numpy as np
def t_statistic(x1, x2):
    x1 = np.asarray(x1, float); x2 = np.asarray(x2, float)
    n1, n2 = x1.size, x2.size
    s1 = x1.var(ddof=1); s2 = x2.var(ddof=1)
    sp = np.sqrt(((n1 - 1) * s1 + (n2 - 1) * s2) / (n1 + n2 - 2))
    return (x1.mean() - x2.mean()) / (sp * np.sqrt(1 / n1 + 1 / n2))

import numpy as np
def entropy_kl(P, Q):
    P = np.asarray(P, float); Q = np.asarray(Q, float); eps = 1e-9
    H = -np.sum(P * np.log2(P + eps))
    KL = np.sum(P * np.log2((P + eps) / (Q + eps)))
    return H, KL

import numpy as np
def lin_reg_gd(X, y, lr=0.01, epochs=1000):
    X = np.asarray(X, float); y = np.asarray(y, float)
    Xb = np.c_[np.ones(len(X)), X]; n = len(Xb)
    theta = np.zeros(Xb.shape[1])
    for _ in range(epochs):
        g = (2 / n) * Xb.T @ (Xb @ theta - y)
        theta = theta - lr * g
    return theta

import numpy as np
def log_reg_gd(X, y, lr=0.1, epochs=1000):
    X = np.asarray(X, float); y = np.asarray(y, float)
    Xb = np.c_[np.ones(len(X)), X]; n = len(Xb)
    theta = np.zeros(Xb.shape[1])
    for _ in range(epochs):
        p = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-(Xb @ theta)))
        g = (1 / n) * Xb.T @ (p - y)
        theta = theta - lr * g
    return theta

import numpy as np
def calc_metrics(y_true, y_pred):
    y_true = np.asarray(y_true); y_pred = np.asarray(y_pred)
    tp = np.sum((y_pred == 1) & (y_true == 1))
    fp = np.sum((y_pred == 1) & (y_true == 0))
    fn = np.sum((y_pred == 0) & (y_true == 1))
    tn = np.sum((y_pred == 0) & (y_true == 0))
    acc = (tp + tn) / len(y_true)
    prec = tp / (tp + fp) if (tp + fp) else 0.0
    rec = tp / (tp + fn) if (tp + fn) else 0.0
    f1 = 2 * prec * rec / (prec + rec) if (prec + rec) else 0.0
    return float(acc), float(prec), float(rec), float(f1)

reference_solution:
import numpy as np
def roc_auc(y_true, y_prob):
    y_true = np.asarray(y_true); y_prob = np.asarray(y_prob, float)
    P = np.sum(y_true == 1); N = np.sum(y_true == 0)
    if P == 0 or N == 0:
        return 0.0
    order = np.argsort(-y_prob)
    yt = y_true[order]
    tpr = np.concatenate([[0], np.cumsum(yt == 1) / P])
    fpr = np.concatenate([[0], np.cumsum(yt == 0) / N])
    return float(np.sum(np.diff(fpr) * (tpr[1:] + tpr[:-1]) / 2))

import numpy as np
def knn(X, y, x_test, k=3):
    X = np.asarray(X, float); y = np.asarray(y); x_test = np.asarray(x_test, float)
    d = np.sqrt(((X - x_test) ** 2).sum(axis=1))
    nn = np.argsort(d)[:k]
    vals, counts = np.unique(y[nn], return_counts=True)
    return int(vals[np.argmax(counts)])

title: Decision Tree Best Split (Gini)

The Gini Impurity of a node is $1 - sum p_i^2$, where $p_i$ is the probability of class $i$.
To evaluate a split, compute the weighted average Gini of the left and right child nodes:

import numpy as np
def batch_norm(X, gamma, beta, eps=1e-5):
    X = np.asarray(X, float)

import numpy as np
def conv2d(image, kernel):
    image = np.asarray(image, dtype=float)
    kernel = np.asarray(kernel, dtype=float)
    kh, kw = kernel.shape
    H, W = image.shape
    oh, ow = H - kh + 1, W - kw + 1
    out = np.zeros((oh, ow))
    for i in range(oh):
        for j in range(ow):
            out[i, j] = (image[i:i+kh, j:j+kw] * kernel).sum()
    return out

import numpy as np
def adam_step(params, grads, m, v, t, lr=0.001, b1=0.9, b2=0.999, eps=1e-8):
    g = np.asarray(grads, float)
    m = b1 * np.asarray(m, float) + (1 - b1) * g
    v = b2 * np.asarray(v, float) + (1 - b2) * g ** 2
    mh = m / (1 - b1 ** t); vh = v / (1 - b2 ** t)
    return np.asarray(params, float) - lr * mh / (np.sqrt(vh) + eps), m, v

reference_solution:
import numpy as np
def _sm(x):
    e = np.exp(x - x.max(axis=-1, keepdims=True)); return e / e.sum(axis=-1, keepdims=True)
def mha(X, W_q, W_k, W_v, W_o, h):
    X = np.asarray(X, float)
    Wq = np.asarray(W_q, float); Wk = np.asarray(W_k, float); Wv = np.asarray(W_v, float); Wo = np.asarray(W_o, float)
    N, dm = X.shape; dh = dm // h
    Q = X @ Wq; K = X @ Wk; V = X @ Wv
    heads = []
    for i in range(h):
        sl = slice(i*dh, (i+1)*dh)
        qi, ki, vi = Q[:, sl], K[:, sl], V[:, sl]
        w = _sm((qi @ ki.T) / np.sqrt(dh))
        heads.append(w @ vi)
    return np.concatenate(heads, axis=-1) @ Wo

import numpy as np
def flash_attn_single_query(q, K, V, block_size):
    q = np.asarray(q, float); K = np.asarray(K, float); V = np.asarray(V, float)
    N, d = K.shape
    m = -np.inf; l = 0.0; O = np.zeros((1, d))
    for s in range(0, N, block_size):
        Kj = K[s:s+block_size]; Vj = V[s:s+block_size]
        sj = q @ Kj.T
        m_new = max(m, sj.max())
        p = np.exp(sj - m_new)
        l_new = l * np.exp(m - m_new) + p.sum()
        O = (O * l * np.exp(m - m_new) + p @ Vj) / l_new
        m, l = m_new, l_new
    return O
